name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Armguards
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Armguards: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vengeance is power. The Zandalar vindicator is such power. The tribe has many enemies. The vindicator exacts retribution on them. No crime against us is unpunished. The vindicator delivers this punishment. Our enemies fear our vengeance. They should. They forever will.
Become one of our vindicators. Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub. Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name. You will be rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you brought the Paragons of Power? Has vengeance been claimed in the name of the Zandalar?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have wrought much vengeance today. You have taken on the visage of the vindicator. You have brought the Blood God's minions to their knees.
Take this. It will fuel your vengeance for the future. You are a friend to the Zandalar now.
